fact: At the project's launch workshop in Rumonge on 19 July 2024, FVS-Amade and the interior ministry's director said the digital registration of births and deaths would take place at the commune seat and in the zones of Rumonge, the 12th commune whose civil-status service is digitalised, where births and deaths had until then been written by hand in registers.
title: Région Sud/Rumonge : Enregistrement numérique à l’Etat-civil
